$:set -euo pipefail
cat AGENTS.md >/dev/null
if test -f README.md; then cat README.md >/dev/null; fi
gh api repos/BestNameYet/Terminals/issues/3 --jq .body >/dev/null
git fetch origin main -q
printf 'REMOTE_MAIN '; git rev-parse origin/main
printf 'REMOTE_FILE_BYTES '; git show origin/main:.devcontainer/devcontainer.json | wc -c
printf 'REMOTE_FILE_BODY_BEGIN\n'
git show origin/main:.devcontainer/devcontainer.json
printf 'REMOTE_FILE_BODY_END\n'
printf 'REMOTE_JSON_VALIDITY '
if git show origin/main:.devcontainer/devcontainer.json | node -e 'let s="";process.stdin.on("data",d=>s+=d);process.stdin.on("end",()=>{try{JSON.parse(s);console.log("valid");}catch(e){console.log("invalid:",e.message);}})'; then :; fi
